Subject: New inbound trial sign-up - CareFlow (requested demo)

Hello team,

A new self-serve sign-up has requested a demo from CareFlow. Details below: 
- Organization: CareFlow
- Contact: Emma Park (emma@careflow.ai)
- Role: Product Lead
- Use case summary: helpdesk automation + routing classification; evaluating inference for triage and response generation
- Estimated monthly volume (self-reported): 50k requests/month
- Preferred timeline: pilot in Q2 (start in May), production H2
- Notes: Interested in private deployment and SSO

Link to sign-up record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/7654321

Please follow up to confirm a short discovery/demo.

--
CareFlow signup portal
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@careflow.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New inbound trial sign-up - CareFlow (requested demo)

Hi Emma —

Congrats on getting started, and thanks for signing up! I’m Ben on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. Quick set of questions so we can make the demo useful and pick the right environment: 

1) Can you confirm the primary flows you want to automate (e.g., triage classification, canned responses, summarization)?
2) For the ~50k/mo you entered: is that 50k short prompts (<=50 tokens) or 50k multi-turn chat interactions? If mixed, please give a split (e.g., 40k classification, 10k generation).
3) Typical request length (avg tokens) and top-k concurrency during peak (approx users concurrently hitting the API)?
4) What’s the ideal pilot start date in May? Any hard blackout dates?
5) SSO / SAML and data residency: do you require enterprise SSO and US-only hosting?

If you can send a small sample (anonymized) traffic CSV and preferred days/times, I’ll book a 30-min demo with an engineer and product manager. My calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/30min 

Suggested windows (Pacific TZ) if helpful:
- Tue 4/5 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 4/6 09:00–09:30 or 14:00–14:30

Thanks — looking forward to learning more.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Park <emma@careflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@careflow.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-30T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareFlow demo: quick qualification + schedule

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick follow. Answers below and I attached a small anonymized traffic sample.

1) Primary flows: incoming ticket classification (assign to team/priority), short automated replies for low-touch tickets, and nightly summarization for managers. No long-form multi-paragraph generation required initially.
2) Volume breakdown: roughly 50k classification calls / month and ~5k lightweight generation calls (templates) / month. So mostly classification.
3) Typical request size: classification payloads average ~30 tokens. Peak concurrency: we expect spikes up to ~60 concurrent inference calls during campaign hours.
4) Pilot timing: aiming to start a 6-week pilot week of May 10th (flexible +/- one week). No hard blackout dates in that period.
5) SSO and residency: we require SAML-based SSO (Okta) and prefer US-region hosting initially.

Attachments: traffic_sample_q1.csv (anonymized), brief_arch_notes.txt (internal)

Let me know which of your suggested windows works; immediate preference is Tue 4/5 15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Emma Park
Product Lead, CareFlow
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@careflow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareFlow demo: quick qualification + schedule

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and for sending the sample — that helps a lot. I downloaded traffic_sample_q1.csv and flagged a few notes for the engineering team. Quick responses and next steps: 

- Volume and token sizes look ideal for a dedicated pilot with prefix/KV caching to keep latency low and cost predictable.
- Peak concurrency of ~60 is well within what we can support on a 1-GPU Dedicated rotor; we will prepare a throughput profile for the demo.
- SSO: we can support Okta SAML for the pilot. I attached our SSO checklist (sso_requirements.pdf) — can you confirm who the Okta admin contact will be?
- Pilot start: May 10th works; I’ll schedule the kickoff for May 10–11 (onboarding + initial run) once we confirm a demo time this week.

Ben — Emma prefers Tue 4/5 15:00 PT (your slot). Can you lock that in and include a short agenda: 1) 10-min discovery/architecture, 2) 15-min live demo using their sample, 3) 5-min next steps/pilot plan.

Emma — attaching the SSO checklist and a short pilot onboarding guide. If you need an interactive SSO session we can add an extra 15 minutes on the call.

Attachments referenced: sso_requirements.pdf, pilot_onboarding_onepager.pdf

Thanks all — see you Tuesday.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
